news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: Revenues and EPS in line with analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹8.29 (up from ₹7.28 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹276.1b (up 16% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹60.6b (up 14% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 22% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) were also in line with analyst expectations. Revenue is forecast to grow 16% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 17% growth forecast for the Aerospace & Defense industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 25% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 56% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Dividend increased to ₹1.95
news.body: Dividend of ₹1.95 is 30% higher than last year. Ex-date: 6th March 2026 Payment date: 29th March 2026 Dividend yield will be 0.6%, which is lower than the industry average of 0.9%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is covered by earnings (11% earnings payout ratio) but not covered by cash flows (184% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 23% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 35% over the next 2 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.
